# Provenance

`websocketpp/` is the header-only WebSocket library behind `ssc/websocket`, vendored from
[`LocutusOfBorg/websocketpp`](https://github.com/LocutusOfBorg/websocketpp) at
`67405e1ab225f20835e4086f89b54b805dd43bae` (`0.6.0-permessage-deflate-268`), a Debian maintainer's
fork of `zaphoyd/websocketpp`, 1788 commits. It is licensed under the BSD 3-clause licence, in `COPYING`.

Only the 93 headers of `websocketpp/` are here, of 272 files.

## Local edits

None. An update is a copy of those headers from a newer commit, plus the edits listed here.
